title: 第8章 一刀，又一刀！
content_zh:
第8章一刀，又一刀！
夜幕如纱笼罩了黑山城，皎洁的月光若水银倾泻满地，流入万户千家。
【炼化进度（67/100）】
最后看了一眼鼎壁上的进度条，杨狱心念一松，已然回到了现实。
接连几次炼化之后，他也掌握了随时结束炼化的窍门，不至于将全部体力消耗完毕才出来。
“越往后，似乎越难了。”
杨狱叹了口气。
结束了一天的炼化，就着月光来到院中。
听着隔壁婆婆沉沉的呼吸，杨狱小心的提起一桶水，浇在磨刀石上，拿着断刀就是一个摩擦。
“这老头，狠人……怪不得胡万这样的糙汉子，见到他就像是老鼠见到猫。”
回想着白日里魏老头那令人发寒的目光，杨狱只觉后背都有些发凉。
这个杀了一辈子人的老刽子手，绝对是他两世为人中所见过对人命最为冷漠的人。
没有之一。
“遵纪守法…”
杨狱咬了咬牙。
前世的他，十二年苦读，已然是即将迈入法学院的新生，虽然还没来得及去上一天学。
可骨子里，还是个遵纪守法的好学生。
断刀划过磨刀石，发出阵阵令人牙酸的声音。
“弘扬民主正气。”
继续磨刀。

“正人先正己。”
“我……”
杨狱心跳如擂鼓，刀都磨的不够利索了。
磨的不爽，他干脆将刀丢到了一边，拿起脚边白天顺路买来的劣质酒水，就着石头，仰头就灌了一口。
“咳咳~”
劣质酒水下肚，一股热气伴随着酒意就涌上了脸。
咳嗽几声，杨狱又举起葫芦，很快，就喝了个干净。
“真难喝啊……”
丢掉葫芦，捡起断刀，杨狱望向天空。
正有风起，吹动云彩，遮住月亮，一时间，夜色似乎更暗了几分。
“这天，真他么的黑！”
重重的打了个酒嗝，杨狱提刀起身，摇摇晃晃的走进了夜色之中。
夜晚的黑山城一片寂静，只有零星的犬吠，猫叫。
踉跄的走在小巷里，杨狱心中一片茫然。
回想起前世所看过的小说，电影，主角一穿越就跟换了个人一样杀伐果断，他心中就不禁摇头。
明明之前还是个连鸡都没有杀过的人。
“或许有着胡万的威慑，他们会偃旗歇鼓……”
杨狱心中杂乱的念头翻飞着。
不知不觉间，已然穿过数条小巷，来到了外城西城区。
耳朵贴在门上，隐隐间，就听到阵阵呻吟，隔着院子，他听得并不真切，却依稀可以分辨出这人是王六。

“王六真在他姘头这，呵，连门都不关。”
杨狱心中一禀。
惊讶于魏老头的消息灵通的同时，向前一挤，进了院子。
“轻，轻点，腰，腰要断了！”
王六赤裸着身子趴在床上，发出惨叫，呻吟。
擦着劣质腮红的妇人轻轻为他上药，嘴里也在叫唤着：“杀千刀的胡屠夫，怎的下如此狠手？”
“疼死老子了！”
王六疼的捶打床板，浑身哆嗦，满头冷汗。
“别嚎了，叫外人听见不好。”
妇人有些担忧的看了一眼窗外。
“你娘的！老子为了你的事被打成这样，你还怕被人听见？怎么的，老子见不得人吗？！”
王六顿时火大，反手一个巴掌抽在妇人脸上。
“哎呦！”
妇人被打的一个趔趄，回过神来，顿时开始撒泼大叫：
“好你个王六，竟敢打老娘！不是你拱老娘门子的时候了，我，我打死你个没良心的！”
这妇人很是泼辣，一顿张牙舞爪让王六也没了脾气，连声讨饶。
擦好了药，王六挣扎着坐起，脸都疼的扭曲：“王八蛋胡万，下手这么黑……”
“杨狱那小畜生，居然搭上了那个老刽子手，这下可是有些麻烦了……”
妇人拢了拢头发，有些担忧，也有些愤恨。
杨狱曾在魏河门下当学徒她也是知道的，可魏河门下的学徒不知多少，真个能被他收入门下的可没有几个。

三年打杂学徒，还要付高昂的学费，有这钱，还不如再加点去武馆学上几手拳脚呢。
“惹不起，还躲不起吗？”
伸手拿起酒碗灌了一口，王六憋屈又愤恨：
“这么一个小畜生，居然害的老子栽了这么大一个跟头……”
憋屈，但无奈。
都说他是个混不吝，可王六很清楚什么人能惹，什么人不能惹。
不然，他早就和那些‘前辈’一样死在臭水沟里了。
一个死了老子，还没有依靠的半大小毛孩子，他自然随手拿捏，可胡万，他可真惹不起。
更别说那魏河魏老头了。
“这泼皮会放弃？”
贴着墙倾听的杨狱心中一动，就听到那妇人冷哼一声。
“哪有这么容易？”
那妇人披上衣服，下意识的看了一眼窗外，压低声音道：“你以为族长看上的是那点田亩？”
“难道不是？”
王六凑上前抱住妇人，心思又有些活跃起来。
“当然不是。”
妇人抿了抿嘴，道：“那点田亩也就咱们心动，族里要的，可是狱卒的名额。”
“狱卒？咱们这可都是父死子替，难不成你们准备……”
王六比划了一下脖子。
“那谁知道？”

妇人摇了摇头：“族里原本是想以操办后事的名义，逼一逼那老婆子，收回田亩房契，之后再将族里老人的名义收养那小畜生……”
“妙啊！法不下家，族里的事，别说胡万，就是魏河，三尺刘也管不着！到时候，嘿嘿……”
屋内两人一人一句说的兴起，门外的杨狱却是胸膛起伏，怒火大炙。
“好狠，好狠！”
杨狱气的脸色发白。
这是真要将他们一家吃干抹净了！
这伙人只怕早已将自己与婆婆的‘后事’都安排好了！
“不说这些了。忍了好几天，可想死我了……”
“哎呀！你不痛了？”
“哪还记得痛？”
“死相！”
听着屋内的污言秽语，杨狱再也压不住心中火气，后退几步，一个发力，撞向紧闭的木门。
门被一下撞开。
就这屋内的烛火，杨狱一眼就看到了抱在一起乱啃的男女，眼神发狠。
一抹腰间，断刀一掀，就向着王六劈了过去。
“啊！你…”
王六被吓的浑身一颤，一下将那妇人推了过去，反身就要去拿床边竖着的刀。
滚烫的鲜血喷了一脸，打湿了杨狱蒙在脸上的破布，也染红了他的双眼。
“死！！！”
睡梦中被蝎子蛰醒，痛的打滚。
content_en:
Chapter 8 One knife, another knife!
The night covered Black Mountain City like a veil, and the bright moonlight poured like mercury all over the ground and flowed into thousands of households.
[Refining progress (67/100)]
Taking one last look at the progress bar on the cauldron wall, Yang Yu felt relieved and had returned to reality.
After refining several times in succession, he also mastered the trick of ending refining at any time, so as not to come out after all his energy was exhausted.
“The further back you go, the harder it seems.”
Yang Prison sighed.
After a day of refining, he came to the courtyard under the moonlight.
Listening to the deep breathing of the mother-in-law next door, Yang Yu carefully picked up a bucket of water, poured it on the whetstone, and rubbed it with the broken knife.
"This old man is ruthless... No wonder a rough guy like Hu Wan, seeing him is like a mouse seeing a cat."
Thinking back to Old Wei's chilling gaze during the day, Yang Yu felt a chill on his back.
This old executioner, who has been killing people all his life, is definitely the most indifferent person to human life that he has ever seen in his two lifetimes.
Not one.
"Abide by the law..."
Yang Prison gritted his teeth.
In his previous life, he studied hard for twelve years and was already a freshman about to enter law school, although he had not had time to go to school for a day.
But deep down, he is still a good student who abides by the law.
The broken knife scratched the whetstone, making a heart-wrenching sound.
"Promote democratic integrity."
Keep sharpening the knife.
"Rectify others first."
"I..."
Yang Yu's heart was beating like a drum, and his knife couldn't be sharpened enough.
Unsatisfied with the sharpening, he simply threw the knife aside, picked up the low-quality wine he bought on the way during the day at his feet, touched the stone, and took a sip.
"Ahem~"
After drinking low-quality wine, a wave of heat rushed to his face along with the alcohol.
After coughing a few times, Yang Yu raised the gourd again and drank it all in no time.
"It tastes really bad..."
Throwing away the gourd and picking up the broken knife, Yang Yu looked at the sky.
The wind was blowing, blowing the clouds and covering the moon. For a moment, the night seemed a little darker.
"It's so dark today!"
After burping heavily, Yang Yu stood up with his knife and staggered into the night.
Black Mountain City was silent at night, with only sporadic barking dogs and meowing cats.
Staggeringly walking in the alley, Yang Yu felt at a loss.
Recalling the novels and movies he had read in his previous life, he couldn't help but shake his head in his heart. The protagonist was as decisive as a different person once he traveled through time.
Obviously, he was a person who had never killed a chicken before.
"Perhaps with Hu Wan's intimidation, they will stop fighting..."
Yang Yu's heart was filled with messy thoughts.
Unknowingly, I had passed through several alleys and arrived at the Xicheng District of the Outer City.
Putting his ear against the door, he could faintly hear moans. Across the yard, he couldn't hear clearly, but he could vaguely tell that this person was Wang Liu.
"Wang Liuzhen is here with his mistress, hehe, he doesn't even close the door."
Yang Yu was heartbroken.
Surprised that Old Man Wei was well informed, he pushed forward and entered the courtyard.
"Be gentle, be gentle, waist, waist is about to break!"
Wang Liu lay naked on the bed, screaming and moaning.
The woman wearing low-quality blush gently applied medicine to him, and she was also shouting: "Butcher Hu, who has killed a thousand cuts, how can he be so cruel?"
"It hurts me to death!"
Wang Liu beat the bed board in pain, trembling all over and sweating all over his head.
"Stop howling, it's not good for outsiders to hear."
The woman glanced out the window worriedly.
"Damn it! I was beaten like this because of you, and you are still afraid of being heard? Why, am I so embarrassed?!"
Wang Liu suddenly became furious and slapped the woman on the face with his backhand.
"Ouch!"
The woman staggered after being beaten. When she recovered, she immediately started shouting:
"How dare you beat me, you bastard! It's not time for you to win over me, I, I'll beat you to death, you heartless one!"
This womanHe was very aggressive, and he showed his teeth and claws so much that Wang Liu lost his temper and even begged for mercy.
After applying the medicine, Wang Liu struggled to sit up, his face contorted in pain: "You bastard Hu Wan, you did it so darkly..."
"That little bastard Yang Prison actually hooked up with the old executioner. Now he's in some trouble..."
The woman brushed her hair, feeling a little worried and a little angry.
She also knew that Yang Yu had been an apprentice under Wei He's sect, but there were not many apprentices under Wei He's sect, and there were only a few who could be accepted by him.
After three years as a handyman apprentice, you still have to pay high tuition. With this money, you might as well add more to go to a martial arts school and learn some skills.
"If you can't afford to provoke me, can you still afford to hide?"
Reaching out to pick up the wine bowl and taking a sip, Wang Liu felt aggrieved and resentful:
"Such a little beast actually caused me such a big fall..."
Frustrated, but helpless.
They say he is a bastard, but Wang Liu knows very well who he can and cannot mess with.
Otherwise, he would have died in the stinking ditch like those 'predecessors'.
He was a little kid who had no one to rely on after his death, so he could naturally take care of him, but Hu Wan, he really couldn't afford to offend him.
Not to mention old man Wei Hewei.
"Will this rogue give up?"
Yang Yu, who was listening against the wall, felt something in his heart when he heard the woman snort coldly.
"How can it be so easy?"
The woman put on her clothes, glanced out the window subconsciously, and lowered her voice: "Do you think the patriarch is interested in those acres of land?"
"Isn't it?"
Wang Liu stepped forward and hugged the woman, his mind became a little active again.
"Of course not."
The woman pursed her lips and said, "That farmland is what we are interested in. What the clan wants is the jailer's quota."
"Prisoner? We are all replaced by fathers and sons. Could it be that you are preparing..."
Wang Liu gestured to his neck.
"Then who knows?"
The woman shook her head: "The clan originally wanted to force the old woman to take back the land deed in the name of arranging funeral arrangements, and then adopt the little beast in the name of the clan elder..."
"Wonderful! The law does not apply to the family. The affairs of the clan, not to mention Hu Wan, even Wei He, even the three-foot Liu can't control it! When the time comes, hehe..."
The two people in the room were excited at the words, but Yang Yu outside the door was heaving with anger.
"So cruel, so cruel!"
Yang Yu's face turned pale with anger.
This is really going to wipe out their entire family!
This group of people is afraid that they have already arranged their ‘future affairs’ with their mother-in-law!
"Stop talking about this. I have endured it for several days, but I miss me so much..."
"Oops! You don't feel any pain anymore?"
"How can you still remember the pain?"
"Death sign!"
Listening to the filthy words in the room, Yang Yu could no longer suppress the anger in his heart. He took a few steps back and slammed into the closed wooden door with all his strength.
The door was knocked open.
With just the candlelight in the room, Yang Yu could see the man and woman hugging each other and gnawing at each other, with fierce eyes.
With a touch of his waist, he lifted the broken knife and struck at Wang Liu.
"Ah! You..."
Wang Liu was so frightened that he trembled all over. He pushed the woman over and turned around to get the knife standing beside the bed.
Hot blood spurted all over Yang Yu's face, wetting the rag covering Yang Yu's face and dyeing his eyes red.
"Die!!!"
I was stung by a scorpion in my sleep and rolled around in pain.
